sources.snippet: Falcon Perception A minimal, readable yet performant PyTorch inference engine implementation of Falcon Perception — a natively multimodal, dense, autoregressive Transformer model that performs object detection, instance segmentation, or OCR from natural language queries.

sources.title: Falcon Perception - Falcon LLM
sources.snippet: Falcon Perception is a multimodal AI model that enables systems to see, read, and understand images using natural language prompts. By combining vision and language capabilities in a single architecture, Falcon Perception simplifies how AI interprets visual information while remaining efficient.
